California NRHP Web Viewer¶

An interactive map of California's National Register of Historic Places (NRHP) buildings and structures, with a per-county summary of how many are listed. Data sourced from the NRIS/California SHPO GIS layers; basemap tiles from USGS The National Map.

Point Map¶

Loads the NRHP building, structure, and county boundary layers, then builds the base interactive map: a USGS Topo basemap with point layers for historic buildings and structures, plus county outlines for reference.

In [1]:
import folium 
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd

hist_building = gpd.read_file(r"C:\Portfolio Projects\NRHP web viewer\Data\California_NRHP_Buildings.gpkg")
hist_structure = gpd.read_file(r"C:\Portfolio Projects\NRHP web viewer\Data\California_NRHP_Site.gpkg")
counties = gpd.read_file(r"C:\Portfolio Projects\NRHP web viewer\Data\CA_Counties.gpkg")

# Reproject counties to epsg 4326, and drop duplicate row
counties = counties.drop_duplicates(subset="COUNTY_NAM").to_crs(epsg=4326)

# A simplified copy of counties used only for rendering. 
counties_simplified = counties.copy()
counties_simplified["geometry"] = counties_simplified.geometry.simplify(
    tolerance=0.001, preserve_topology=True
)

# Trim down Structure and Building Fields
fields = ['geometry', 'RESNAME', 'NRIS_Refnum']
hist_building_small = hist_building[fields]
hist_structure_small = hist_structure[fields]

m = folium.Map(tiles=None, location=(37.16, -119.44))

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles="https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSTopo/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    attr="USGS The National Map",
    name="USGS Topo",
    control=False,
).add_to(m)

# Add California Counties the map frame
folium.GeoJson(counties_simplified, 
               name="California Counties",
               tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(fields=['COUNTY_NAM'],aliases=['County Name'])
               ).add_to(m)

# Add the Historic Buildings to the map as red points
folium.GeoJson(
    hist_building_small,
    name= "Historic Building",
    marker=folium.CircleMarker(radius=2, fill=True, color='red', fill_opacity=0.8),
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(fields=['RESNAME', 'NRIS_Refnum']),
).add_to(m)

# Add the Historic Structures to the map as yellow points
folium.GeoJson(
    hist_structure_small,
    name="Historic Structure",
    marker=folium.CircleMarker(radius=2, fill=True, color="yellow",fill_opacity=0.8),
    tooltip=folium.GeoJsonTooltip(fields=['RESNAME', 'NRIS_Refnum'])
).add_to(m)


# Zoom to the California Extent
bounds = hist_building.total_bounds  # [minx, miny, maxx, maxy]
m.fit_bounds([[bounds[1], bounds[0]], [bounds[3], bounds[2]]])
m

County Counts¶

Spatially joins the building and structure points to their containing county, then aggregates each into a per-county count. The two counts are merged into a single county_counts table used by the choropleth maps below.

In [2]:
building_count = counties.sjoin(hist_building_small, how="left")
structure_count = counties.sjoin(hist_structure_small, how="left")

county_building_counts = (
    building_count.groupby('COUNTY_NAM')
    .size()
    .rename('building_count')
    .reset_index()
)

county_structure_counts = (
    structure_count.groupby('COUNTY_NAM')
    .size()
    .rename('structure_count')
    .reset_index()
)

county_counts = county_building_counts.merge(county_structure_counts, on='COUNTY_NAM', how='outer')
print(county_counts)

Building Choropleth¶

Colors each county by its NRHP building count, using natural-breaks (Jenks) bins to account for the strong right skew in the data (Los Angeles County alone accounts for 381 of the state's listings). Hover a county for its exact count.

In [3]:
building_choro = folium.Map(tiles=None, location=(37.16, -119.44))

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles="https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSTopo/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    attr="USGS The National Map",
    name="USGS Topo",
    control=False,
).add_to(building_choro)

counties_with_counts = counties_simplified.merge(county_counts, on="COUNTY_NAM", how="left")

b_choropleth = folium.Choropleth(
    geo_data=counties_with_counts,
    data=county_counts,
    columns=["COUNTY_NAM", "building_count"],
    key_on="feature.properties.COUNTY_NAM",
    fill_color="YlGn",
    fill_opacity=1,
    bins=[1,16,45,96,131,381],
).add_to(building_choro)

b_choropleth.geojson.add_child(
    folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=["COUNTY_NAM", "building_count"],
        aliases=["County Name:", "NRHP Buildings:"],
    )
)

bounds = hist_building.total_bounds 
building_choro.fit_bounds([[bounds[1], bounds[0]], [bounds[3], bounds[2]]])

building_choro

Structure Choropleth¶

Same approach as above, colored by NRHP structure count instead of buildings. Structures are far less numerous per county (mostly 1, up to 5), so this uses simple integer bins rather than natural breaks.

In [4]:
structure_choro = folium.Map(tiles=None, location=(37.16, -119.44))

folium.TileLayer(
    tiles="https://basemap.nationalmap.gov/arcgis/rest/services/USGSTopo/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
    attr="USGS The National Map",
    name="USGS Topo",
    control=False,
).add_to(structure_choro)

counties_with_counts = counties_simplified.merge(county_counts, on="COUNTY_NAM", how="left")

s_chropleth = folium.Choropleth(
    geo_data=counties_with_counts,
    data=county_counts,
    columns=["COUNTY_NAM", "structure_count"],
    key_on="feature.properties.COUNTY_NAM",
    fill_color="YlGn",
    fill_opacity=1,
    bins=[1,2,3,4,5]
).add_to(structure_choro)

s_chropleth.geojson.add_child(
    folium.GeoJsonTooltip(
        fields=["COUNTY_NAM", "structure_count"],
        aliases=["County Name:", "NRHP Structure:"],
    )
)

bounds = hist_building.total_bounds 
structure_choro.fit_bounds([[bounds[1], bounds[0]], [bounds[3], bounds[2]]])

structure_choro
